title: NANSEN table sidecar
description: Describes one entity table stored as CSV: the column names and types, the key, and the fragment versions the columns follow. The sidecar alone is enough to read the CSV; no fragment definition or module code is needed.

file.description: File name of the CSV, in the same folder as the sidecar.

revision.description: Save counter. A writer refuses to save when the revision on disk differs from the one it read (optimistic concurrency), and increments it on save.

key.description: Columns whose values together identify a row: the entity's identity and its ancestors' identity, outermost first.

columns.description: Columns in the order they appear in the CSV header.

fragments.description: The fragments whose columns this table holds, and the version of each.

fragment.description: Id of the fragment this column belongs to. Absent for key columns and other columns no fragment owns.
